dfkup package management on top of datpkgr.

Owns the ~/.dfkup home (DFKUP_HOME overrides it): datpkgr keeps its databases, packages/, develop/ and caches there, and dfkup adds libraries/ for shared libraries (see stdlibLibPath). The home is created on the first package operation - there is no setup step.

Packages are kup source trees declared by package.kup (see pkgmanifest). This phase supports installs by git URL and editable develop checkouts; registry-backed installs arrive with the dfkup packages source.

NOTE: importing datpkgr/operations pulls the install thread pool, so any binary linking this module must build with --threads:on (the dfkup host does; see src/dfkup.nims).

    ...raises: [Exception, StorageError, KeyError],
    tags: [ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect, RootEffect], forbids: [].}

Make sure the dfkup registry source is registered. Fresh homes get it from datpkgr's own defaults; homes created before the registry existed carry a sourceless sources.json that ensureSourcesFile never upgrades (it only writes when missing), so add it here.

NB: consult the raw file, not loadSources - its fallback fabricates a usable-looking entry named defaultSourceName when the file yields nothing, which is indistinguishable from a registered source.

    ReadEnvEffect, ReadIOEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteDirEffect, WriteIOEffect,
    RootEffect], forbids: [].}
datpkgr config rooted at the dfkup home, wired to package.kup manifests, the dfkup packages registry and plain CLI logging. rootPath overrides the home (tests point it at a temp dir for hermetic runs). ensureSource = false skips the home-dir IO; the caller must then run ensurePkgSource before resolving — exec defers it to the first pkg/ import so plain run scripts never touch the home dir.
